name: Linguini Nero: Squid Ink Pasta with Garlic Shrimp & Calamari (Groot Remix Night 2)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Worlds of Marvel (Celebration of Heroes: Groot Remix Night 2)
whyItWorks: Refined squid-ink wheat pasta and shrimp are low-fiber, though squid ink turns stool dark black (harmless but alarming if unprepared) and calamari rings are chewy.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for no chili flakes and light garlic; eat the pasta and shrimp (leave chewy calamari rings if flaring). Note: squid ink naturally darkens stool the next day.
watchOuts: Squid ink temporarily turns stool black
Garlic and crushed red pepper in sauce
